about: Captions and planned times (Central) for the four Halloween shorts, Oct. 20, 2026. Nothing posts without Scoop's OK. The pictures are real: public domain, or CC BY (no share-alike), and every CC BY photographer is credited on screen and in each post (YouTube gets the license links).
